title: Wedding planner: a file of tasks, version 1
description: A list of tasks to upload at the bottom of the planner's task list. Every row has a key that its author chooses; the planner remembers it. Uploading a file again changes the tasks the planner already has from it, in the fields the row gives and only there, and adds the rows whose key is new. A field that is left out is not touched; a field given as null is emptied. Nothing in a file removes a task. A file is taken whole or not at all, and is at most 1 MB.

key.description: What this row is known by. Any text its author chooses; no two rows of a file share one, and capital and small letters are different keys. No line break, and no space at its beginning or end.

title.description: What is to be done. Not only spaces.

notes.description: Anything else worth knowing. An empty text empties the notes.

dueDate.description: The day it is due, YYYY-MM-DD, or null for none.

status.description: Left out, a new task is NOT_STARTED and a task the planner has keeps its status.

priority.description: null lets the planner set the priority from the dates.

category.description: The name of a category, or null for none. A name the planner does not have yet is added as a category. Compared without regard to capital letters and to spaces around it.

vendor.description: The name of a vendor the planner already has, or null for none. Compared like a category's name. A vendor is never made from a file.

amount.description: With an amount the task is a payment. null for none.

paidOn.description: The day a payment was paid, YYYY-MM-DD, or null. Needs an amount and the status DONE, and is not in the future.

value.description: The amount as people write it, without separators: "12000", "12000.00", or the same as a number. Not negative, and with no more decimals than the currency has. Nothing is rounded.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the wedding's currency. An amount in another currency is refused.
